# NameToColor

> NameToColor is a zero-dependency JavaScript library for web browsers that converts text, IDs, color names, and common color formats into deterministic hexadecimal colors.

The core library is English-only and runs directly in the browser without Node.js, imports, or build tooling. Optional data-only language packs add translated color names, input aliases, theme aliases, and localized labels without replacing the English data.

The built-in database contains 2,254 hashless hexadecimal-to-name pairs and 2,362 English names. Internal color keys use six hexadecimal digits without `#`, for example `"000000": ["Black"]`. Public APIs continue to accept and return standard colors such as `#000000`.

Primary global APIs include `generateColor()`, `generateReadableColor()`, `generateThemePalette()`, `listColors()`, `colorName()`, `colorNames()`, color harmony generators, accessibility checks, temperature classification, and mood classification.

## For AI agents and coding agents

Prefer using the library directly over calling the Vercel REST API whenever JavaScript is available:

1. **Load the script via CDN** (recommended): include `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/zonaro/NameToColor@main/NameToColor.js` with a `<script>` tag and call the global functions (`generateColor()`, `generateReadableColor()`, `generateThemePalette()`, `listColors()`, etc.) directly in the browser.
2. **Download a local copy** of `NameToColor.js` (and optionally `NameToColor.ptBR.js`) when you need offline or vendored usage.
3. **Use the Vercel REST API only as a fallback** — when the environment cannot execute JavaScript (no browser, no JS runtime) or you only need a single HTTP request.

## Free REST API

NameToColor also exposes a public, free REST API hosted on Vercel. It converts a word into a deterministic hexadecimal color with a single GET request. CORS is fully open (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`), so it can be called directly from any browser. **This API is a fallback** — prefer the CDN script or a local copy of the library whenever JavaScript is available.

The API loads the Brazilian Portuguese language pack alongside the English core. Functions that return names or labels (`colorName`, `colorNames`, `closestName`, `closestNames`, `mood`, `listColors`) accept a `locale` query parameter — defaulting to **English** when omitted. Portuguese inputs (`vermelho`, `azul mais escuro`, `natureza`) work out of the box.

- Endpoint: `GET /api/color?func=generateColor&name=palavra`, or `GET /api/color?name=palavra` (when `func` is omitted, ALL basic functions run and `generateColor` is included)
- Success (`200`) single: `{"func": "generateColor", "name": "palavra", "result": "#hexadecimal"}`
- Success (`200`) batch: `{"generateColor": "#hexadecimal", "colorName": "...", ...}` (when `func` is omitted; base color shared so the palette matches)
- Unknown `func` (`400`): `{"error": "Unknown function ...", "available": [...]}`
- Non-GET method (`405`): `{"error": "Method not allowed..."}`
- Implementation: a single Vercel Serverless Function in `api/color.js` that dispatches to every library function. The Vercel Hobby plan limits a deployment to 12 Serverless Functions, so all functions share one endpoint. The same file remains browser-compatible via a plain `<script>` tag.

### Single dispatcher endpoint

The API is a single endpoint: `GET /api/color?func={function}&param1=value1&param2=value2`. The `func` query parameter selects the library function to call; every other query parameter is passed to that function. The response mirrors the request: `{ func, ...params, result }`.

When `func` is omitted, **all basic functions run at once** and the response maps each function name to its result, e.g. `{ "generateColor": "#ff0000", "colorName": "Red", ... }`. In batch mode `count` defaults to `5` and `locale` defaults to an empty string (English). When `input` is missing, empty or `"random"`, `generateColor` resolves the base color once and it is shared by every other function, so the whole palette matches; a provided `name` anchors that base.

- `func=generateColor&name=...` → `{ func, name, result: "#hex" }`
- `func=generateReadableColor&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: [textColor, bgColor] }`
- `func=generateThemePalette&input=...&count=...` → `{ func, input, count, result: string[] }`
- `func=listColors&page=...&size=...&locale=...` → `{ func, page, size, locale, result: { items, pageNumber, pageCount, totalItems } }`
- `func=colorName&input=...&locale=...` → `{ func, input, locale, result: string | null }`
- `func=colorNames&input=...&locale=...` → `{ func, input, locale, result: string[] }`
- `func=closestName&input=...&locale=...` → `{ func, input, locale, result: string | null }`
- `func=closestNames&input=...&locale=...` → `{ func, input, locale, result: string[] }`
- `func=generateInvertedColor&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: string }`
- `func=generateComplementary&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: string }`
- `func=generateTriadic&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: string[] }`
- `func=generateSquare&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: string[] }`
- `func=generateSplitComplementary&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: string[] }`
- `func=generateMonochrome&input=...&count=...` → `{ func, input, count, result: string[] }`
- `func=hexToRgb&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: { r, g, b } }`
- `func=hexToHsl&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: { h, s, l } }`
- `func=hslToHex&h=...&s=...&l=...` → `{ func, h, s, l, result: string }`
- `func=relativeLuminance&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: number }`
- `func=normalizeHex&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: string }`
- `func=isLight&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: boolean }`
- `func=isDark&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: boolean }`
- `func=isHot&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: boolean }`
- `func=isCold&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: boolean }`
- `func=temperature&input=...` → `{ func, input, result: string }`
- `func=mood&input=...&locale=...` → `{ func, input, locale, result: string[] }`
- `func=isReadableForBlindness&colorA=...&colorB=...&type=...` → `{ func, colorA, colorB, type, result: { readable, contrast, ... } }`
- `func=listNameToColorLanguages` → `{ func, result: array }`
- `func=colorDatabase` → `{ func, result: object }`

Note: the conversion functions `hexToRgb`, `hexToHsl`, and `hslToHex` are single-dispatch only — they are not included in the batch response.

All endpoints share the same behavior: CORS fully open (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`), `OPTIONS` preflight returns `204`, non-GET methods return `405`, and missing/unknown parameters return `400` with `{"error": "..."}`. Implementation: one Vercel Serverless Function (`api/color.js`) that dispatches to every library function, plus shared HTTP helpers in `lib/api-helpers.js`. The core `NameToColor.js` is imported through CommonJS; the same file remains browser-compatible via a plain `<script>` tag.

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zonaro/NameToColor/main/README.md): Complete installation guide, API reference, examples, input processing rules, language-pack format, and database format.
- [Interactive documentation](https://zonaro.github.io/NameToColor/): Semantic HTML documentation and live browser playground for the public API.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/zonaro/NameToColor): Canonical source repository and project history.
- [Core browser library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zonaro/NameToColor/main/NameToColor.js): English implementation and built-in color database.
- [Brazilian Portuguese language pack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zonaro/NameToColor/main/NameToColor.ptBR.js): Optional data-only `pt-BR` translations and aliases.
- [Vercel serverless API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zonaro/NameToColor/main/api/color.js): Free REST endpoint that dispatches to every library function and reuses the core library.
- [Vercel API source](https://github.com/zonaro/NameToColor/tree/main/api): The single dispatcher serverless function, plus shared HTTP helpers in `lib/api-helpers.js`.

## CDN (preferred)

- [CDN build](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/zonaro/NameToColor@main/NameToColor.js): Direct browser-ready core script served from jsDelivr. **Preferred over the REST API** whenever JavaScript is available.
